caption: Department of Homeland Security v. League of Women Voters
author: Per Curiam
holding: The Court grants the Government’s application to stay the District Court’s order—which set aside and vacated the Government’s modified Systematic Alien Verification for Entitlements (SAVE) program and its related notices—pending the disposition of appeal to the United States Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia and disposition of a petition for a writ of certiorari, if such a writ is timely sought.
writings: Jackson, joined by Sotomayor and Kagan, dissenting
